name: demoscene-classics
description: Beginner-friendly browser scripts for classic Canvas 2D demoscene effects.

scripts.test:visual: npm run build && node scripts/visual-capture.mjs --out visual/captures && node scripts/visual-compare.mjs
scripts.visual:update: npm run build && node scripts/visual-capture.mjs --out visual/baselines && node scripts/visual-contact-sheet.mjs --source visual/baselines
scripts.test:gallery:visual: npm run build && node scripts/gallery-capture.mjs --out visual/captures/gallery && node scripts/gallery-compare.mjs
scripts.gallery:update: npm run build && node scripts/gallery-capture.mjs --out visual/baselines/gallery
